name: Lunette
source:
A hot-tempered, aggressive wolf-girl.
According to rumors, her parents run a mafia clan. Thanks to this, she knows about combat magic much more than others, but she also has the most serious problem with controlling her power.
This girl will definitely be a challenge...
She is already perfectly able to stand up for herself and it is better not to arouse the anger of her patrons...
